artworks.title: The Great Russian Ball at the Academy of Music, November 5, 1863
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ballroom with dancers. The scene depicts couples dancing in a grand ballroom with a sizeable audience. The architecture is detailed, with ornate designs on the walls and ceilings, and a large chandelier. The women wear elegant gowns and the men are in formal wear. The drawing conveys movement and festivity, with a lively atmosphere of celebration in a high society setting.

artworks.title: Campaign Sketches: The Letter for Home
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman sitting beside a man in bed. The woman has sculptured facial features and is sitting upright with her body turned towards the man. She is wearing a dark-colored gown with a hooded cloak and has a scarf loosely wrapped around her head. She is holding an open book or document. The man is lying on his side with his eyes closed, resting on a pillow. He has short hair and a beard, wearing a light shirt. There is a cup on a table beside the bed. The room has large windows, multiple beds, and other figures present.

artworks.title: Campaign Sketches: Our Jolly Cook
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a dynamic pose, holding an object in his hands. He is surrounded by other men who appear to be soldiers, some seated and others standing. The background includes tents and soldiers observing the scene. Smoke is visible near the ground.

artworks.title: The Ass at School
artworks.artist: Pieter van der Heyden after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 23.6 x 30.4 cm (9 5/16 x 11 15/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey as an addition to the Addie Burr Clark Memorial Collection
artworks.description: This print shows a chaotic classroom scene, with young students engaging in various activities, some appearing mischievous and inattentive. In the top left corner, a donkey stands on its back feet behind a desk, one of its front hooves resting on the surface next to a page of sheet music. Also on the desk is a lit candle and what appears to be a pair of glasses. In the center of the print, an adult figure in a long dress with a feathered hat is in the middle of a group of small figures. Some of the students hold sheets of paper or large books, while others interact with one another, making strange expressions, or sit in various buckets and baskets. Other objects fill the space, like low benches, vases, and discarded books. In the background, a tall figure appears to be standing in an enclosed space with a barred window.

artworks.title: La Ferme aux peupliers de Hollande
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Jane C. Carey as an addition to the Addie Burr Clark Memorial Collection
artworks.description: The image shows an etching of a landscape with trees, a cottage, and a farmhouse. The viewpoint is from the ground, looking across the tree-filled scene. The trees have leaning trunks and branches reaching upwards. The horizon is low, emphasizing the trees. The line work of the etching is intricate and fluid, capturing the movement of branches and landscape texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with black ink on a light background. The tree forms closest to us are prominent, leading the eye along the trunks. The sunlight filters through the leaves. Buildings are seen in the distance among the trees.

artworks.title: Ath. L. Charles Coquerel
artworks.description: The image shows a cartoonish figure standing upright. The person has their hands clasped together in front of their body. They have exaggerated facial features, including a large forehead, prominent eyebrows, sideburns, and round glasses. The figure has short, dark hair and is wearing a formal suit with a dark jacket, white shirt or cravat, and dark trousers. The illustration uses shading to show depth and texture in the clothing. The background is a simple, shaded area with no additional objects or details.

artworks.title: Ath. L. Charles Coquerel
artworks.description: The image is a caricature of a man standing with his hands clasped in front of him. He has a large forehead, exaggerated facial features, round spectacles, dark shoulder-length hair with sideburns, and is wearing a dark suit. The background is simple with sketchy lines and small dots.

artworks.title: Frontispiece: Allegorical Composition (Composition allegorique)
artworks.artist: Gabriel Jacques de Saint-Aubin and Charles Francois Le Tellier
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing confidently with one arm resting on a tall tool or staff, the other hand on their hip. The person has distinct facial features and styled hair with a feathered ornament. They wear a skirt-like garment made of feathers. Various objects are around them, including a cylindrical item and a container on the ground. In the background are skies, a tree, hills, and seated figures. The scene is rendered in a detailed, monochromatic sketch style.

artworks.title: Heroic Act of a Father Who Sacrifices for His Son (Trait heroique d'un pere qui se sacrifie pour son fils)
artworks.artist: Gabriel Jacques de Saint-Aubin and Charles Francois Le Tellier
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring multiple figures under a large tree. Some figures appear distressed, while others seem to be in motion. The composition is packed with activity and some figures are partly or fully unclothed. The intricate tree serves as a backdrop. The artwork has detailed line work and shading, creating depth and emotion. There is text at the bottom that adds a poetic touch, hinting at themes of sacrifice and protection.

artworks.title: Envoy to M. de Saint-Denis by M. de Belle-Isle, Prisoner [left]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythical figure in a dynamic pose. The scene depicts a satyr-like creature in a movement-filled composition, with the figure appearing to be caught mid-stride against a natural backdrop. The creature is unclothed, save for a small cloth around its waist, and is holding a sheet of paper with a goblet in its other hand. Its posture suggests motion, as if it is prancing or running in a landscape. The backdrop features lightly sketched trees and clouds, adding depth to the scene. The drawing is marked by fine lines and subtle shading.

artworks.title: Flight of M. de Belle-Isle, Prisoner with theAttakapas [right]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with animals and rustic surroundings. The drawing depicts a group of figures, accompanied by a horse, set against a backdrop of a large tree and rustic huts. There is a lush tree in the background with branches extending and a detailed rendering of large leaves. The earth is uneven and textured, while the hut appears to have a thatched roof. Various elements, like a shepherd's staff and a knife, suggest a bucolic lifestyle. The drawing portrays nature in intricate detail with fine, cross-hatched shading and delicate line work.

artworks.title: A Blacksmith (Un Forgeron)
artworks.medium: aquatint and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of two figures. One figure is in the foreground, standing upright with a muscular build, curly hair, and wearing an open-collared shirt with rolled-up sleeves. This figure's face is obscured by shadow. One arm is extended sideways, and the other rests on an open book. In the background, another figure is partially visible leaning over a table. The scene is dark, with no discernible details other than the figures, some architectural outlines, and a decorative border with etched patterns and a small bird-like creature at the bottom left.

artworks.title: The Comedy of Death
artworks.description: This drawing depicts a landscape with skeletal figures, barren trees, a reflective body of water surrounded by roots and skulls, and skeletal remains on the ground. Twisted trees with anthropomorphic features hold dancing skeletons in their branches. Swirling clouds fill the sky, creating a chaotic atmosphere. The composition is detailed and imaginative, portraying death and decay.

artworks.title: Un quiproquo - Vous vous trompez... allez... au diable...
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration showing three individuals in a domestic setting. The first person is fully shown on the left side of the image, appearing to burst through a door while bending forward with raised hands. They are dressed in a suit with a tall hat. The second person stands behind a table covered with a cloth and various dishes, including a loaf of bread. This person appears startled with hands raised in surprise and is wearing a long-sleeved dress. The third person is seated at the table, visible in profile from the right side of the image, wearing a robe or nightshirt. Their hair is dark and sleeked back, and they seem to be turning towards the commotion. Beside the chair, there is a small spill of liquid or debris on the floor. The room has plain walls with a decorative wall mount and appears to be simply furnished.

artworks.title: Lagrange
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a person standing with arms crossed. The person is in a slightly turned posture facing right, with exaggerated long legs and slender appearance. The facial features are sharply defined, with an elongated nose, strong chin, wide and expressive eyes. The person has long, wild, wavy hair blown back. They wear a detailed shirt with an elaborate collar, a long coat, form-fitting pants with vertical stripes, and elongated shoes. The background is a simple sketchpad-like surface.

artworks.title: Auguste Avond
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature drawing of a person sitting on a rectangular block with crossed legs and folded arms. The person has exaggerated facial features, a serious expression, and voluminous, wavy, dark hair covering the ears. They are dressed in a patterned jacket, white shirt, plaid trousers, and pointed shoes. There are no visible accessories. The background is plain, with simple shading.

artworks.title: Alex. Thomas Marie
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body drawing of a person standing upright in a side profile position. The person has a pronounced facial structure with long nose, expressive forehead, and curly hair falling to their shoulders. They are dressed in formal attire, consisting of a dark coat, fitted pants, and a ruffled white shirt at the neck. The individual's arms are clasped behind them, holding a monocle. The background features a faint outline of a courtroom setting with indistinct figures seated in rows.

artworks.title: Jos. Ant. Ronjac
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of a person standing upright with arms folded. The individual has exaggerated facial features, including a large forehead, bushy eyebrows, and a full beard and mustache. The person's hair is long, flowing down past the shoulders. They wear a long, dark double-breasted coat, white shirt, trousers, and pointed shoes. In the background, there is a sketched crowd of indistinct figures and simple lines suggesting architectural elements.

artworks.title: Gustave Sautayra
artworks.description: The image depicts a cartoon-style drawing of a man standing with his arms crossed confidently. The man has exaggerated facial features such as a large nose, bushy eyebrows, and a thick black mustache. His hair is short and slightly tousled. He is wearing a formal suit with a high-collared shirt and bow tie. The background shows sketchy figures, implying a gathering of people.

artworks.title: Le Jeune Estancelin est obligé de rentrer en classe!
artworks.description: The image shows a slender figure with exaggerated features in profile, walking. The person has a large forehead, pronounced facial features, and short, dark hair. They wear a black top and checkered pants, holding a basket in their left hand and a handkerchief to their face with the other hand. Objects such as a ball, doll, rug, and cylindrical items are scattered around. In the background, there is an illustration of a covered wagon with horses and trees on the left.

artworks.title: Le Jeune Estancelin est obligé de rentrer en classe!
artworks.description: The image shows a young boy in profile view with exaggerated facial features, holding a handkerchief to his face with tears falling. He is dressed in a dark long-sleeved shirt and checkered trousers, holding a basket under his arm. The ground is scattered with flat leaves and a round object resembling a ball. A pig stands in front of him, looking up curiously. In the background, there is a structure resembling a small building or cart, with figures nearby and trees/bushes in a sparsely detailed landscape.

artworks.title: Les Délégués du club central socialiste ont repoussé...
artworks.description: The image depicts three women standing closely together. Two women on the left lean towards a document held by the woman in the center, who is reading it. The woman on the left has curly hair and wears a cloak or shawl, while the woman in the center has wavy hair. The woman on the right wears a bonnet and looks astonished. They wear layered clothing with long skirts and cloaks. One woman holds part of the document. The background is plain and the text and printing details are above and below the image.

artworks.title: Quand un orateur ennuyeux monte a la tribune
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a courtroom scene in a caricature style. The image features two panels arranged vertically. In the upper panel, there is a large figure sitting down with an expressive face, surrounded by other figures. The lower panel shows another figure standing and gesturing towards a seated figure next to a judgment bench. The characters have exaggerated features and the lines are sketchy, reminiscent of 19th-century caricature art.

artworks.title: Oui, ma chère, mon mari a ravalé ma dignité...
artworks.description: The image shows two women intimately interacting in a close embrace. The woman on the left appears older, with a shawl or veil covering her head. The younger woman on the right has her hair tied back and is leaning towards the older woman, with her head resting on the elder's shoulder or chest area. Both women are dressed in long, flowing gowns with striped or textured patterns. The setting appears to be indoors, as indicated by a curtain on the right side of the image and a wall with an indistinct, possibly floral pattern in the background.
